## Personality

Plain, plodding, and conscientious, Jane Andrews possesses unflappable nerves that keep her from being easily rattled. Highly capable in domestic science, she has earned honors in the subject while also harboring a somewhat materialistic perspective, believing diamonds can offer great comfort. She is motivated to dedicate her entire life to teaching for the earned salary, firmly intending never to marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

Jane Andrews is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She joined a story club alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Ruby. Later, [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) drove [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). Following Anne's successful performances at the concert, [Jane](../character/jane.md) enjoyed supper with her friends before taking the moonlight drive home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close friends and school playmates. They share social gatherings, including school outings, gatherings with classmates, and trip together to events like the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) concert. Their bond is built on their shared childhood experiences and mutual group of friends in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Friend of — playmates and close friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P40](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0040)</sub>

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) is Jane's brother. He provides transportation for [Jane](../character/jane.md) and her friends, driving them to events such as the benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) and returning them home safely afterward.

- Sibling of — brother and sister driving together to a concert  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

### [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon is a local community member who saved [Jane](../character/jane.md) from a dangerous fall. When she nearly fell overboard into the lake, Harmon caught her by her sash to keep her safe.

- Saved by — caught her by her sash as she nearly fell overboard into the lake  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
